title: mono: rename billingUrl->billingEndpoint in shared-contracts and core-shell, billing, reports apps (single PR)
platformkit: no references to billingUrl; no change needed

summary: Renamed billingUrl->billingEndpoint (same value) in libs/shared-contracts and its consumers core-shell, sub-route-billing, sub-route-reports in one mono PR (#1); CI and CD green. Assumptions: platform-kit has no reference to the setting so needed no change/release; shared-contracts is inlined at build time so no registry publish. Local builds of core-shell and billing passed; reports build not verified locally (npm registry env missing in that shell), CI covers only shell+billing.
